title: Cuchulin, Conn of hundred battles
html_source: Traditional Irish mythological hero. Much invoked by Joyce’s contemporary, William Butler Yeats.

anchor.prefix: tones which jangled at every movement of his portentous frame and on these were graven with rude yet striking art the tribal images of many Irish heroes and heroines of antiquity,
